user.title: Add a snapshot classifier
user.description: Classify the snapshot of a camera with an image model trained on Teachable Machine (teachablemachine.withgoogle.com). Export it as "Tensorflow Lite" → "Floating point" and upload the downloaded .zip.

data_description.name: For example "Parking spot". Used as device name.
data_description.camera_entity_id: The camera whose snapshot is analyzed.
data_description.model_file: The converted_tflite.zip archive containing model_unquant.tflite and labels.txt.

classes.title: Classes
classes.description:
Classes found in the model: {classes}.

Both choices are optional.

data_description.empty_class: Creates an "Occupied" sensor that is on when this class has a probability below 50%.
data_description.target_class: Creates a "[class] present" sensor that is on when this class has a probability of 50% or more.

error.invalid_archive: The file is not a valid .zip archive.
error.missing_model: No .tflite model found in the archive. Export from Teachable Machine with "Tensorflow Lite" → "Floating point".
error.missing_labels: labels.txt not found in the archive.
error.invalid_labels: labels.txt is empty, unreadable or contains duplicate classes.
error.invalid_model: The .tflite file is not a valid TensorFlow Lite model.
error.unsupported_quantized: This is a quantized model, which is not supported. In Teachable Machine export the model as "Tensorflow Lite" → "Floating point".
error.unsupported_model: The model is not supported ({details}). Export it from Teachable Machine (Image project) as "Tensorflow Lite" → "Floating point".
error.label_mismatch: The model has {outputs} outputs but labels.txt lists {labels} classes.

data_description.threshold: Under this probability the result is "Uncertain".
data_description.update_mode: Watching a camera attribute analyzes each new snapshot (e.g. the "timestamp" attribute of ring-mqtt cameras). Do not use entity_picture/access_token: it changes every few minutes even without a new image.
data_description.watch_attribute: Used with "When the camera attribute changes". Default: timestamp.
data_description.scan_interval: Used with "At a fixed interval". Unchanged images are not analyzed again.
data_description.empty_class: Creates an "Occupied" sensor that is on when this class has a probability below 50%.
data_description.target_class: Creates a "[class] present" sensor that is on when this class has a probability of 50% or more.
data_description.uncertain_snapshot_dir: Optional, e.g. /media/snapshot_classifier/uncertain. Uncertain snapshots are saved here (full image) so you can add them to the training data. Must be an allowed folder (/media is allowed by default).
data_description.model_file: Optional: upload a retrained Teachable Machine export. Entities are kept.

crop.name: Crop
crop.description: Optional area of the image to analyze, in fractions of width/height (0-1), applied before the centre square crop. Use the same crop for the training pictures (service snapshot_classifier.export_crops).

data_description.x: Left edge, as a fraction of the image width (0 = left).
data_description.y: Top edge, as a fraction of the image height (0 = top).
data_description.width: Width as a fraction of the image width (1 = whole image).
data_description.height: Height as a fraction of the image height (1 = whole image).

classes.title: Classes
classes.description:
Classes found in the model: {classes}.

Both choices are optional.

data_description.empty_class: Creates an "Occupied" sensor that is on when this class has a probability below 50%.
data_description.target_class: Creates a "[class] present" sensor that is on when this class has a probability of 50% or more.

error.invalid_archive: The file is not a valid .zip archive.
error.missing_model: No .tflite model found in the archive. Export from Teachable Machine with "Tensorflow Lite" → "Floating point".
error.missing_labels: labels.txt not found in the archive.

error.invalid_model: The .tflite file is not a valid TensorFlow Lite model.
error.unsupported_quantized: This is a quantized model, which is not supported. In Teachable Machine export the model as "Tensorflow Lite" → "Floating point".
error.unsupported_model: The model is not supported ({details}). Export it from Teachable Machine (Image project) as "Tensorflow Lite" → "Floating point".

error.invalid_crop: Invalid crop: width and height must be greater than 0 and the box must be inside the image (x + width ≤ 1, y + height ≤ 1).
error.path_not_allowed: Use an absolute path inside an allowed folder (allowlist_external_dirs, /media is allowed by default).

export_crops.name: Export crops
export_crops.description: Crops every image of a folder into another folder with the same crop used by a classifier, to prepare the training pictures for Teachable Machine.

source.name: Source folder
source.description: Folder with the original pictures, e.g. /media/parking.

destination.name: Destination folder
destination.description: Folder where the cropped pictures are written (same file names).

config_entry_id.name: Classifier
config_entry_id.description: Use the crop configured for this classifier. The left/top/width/height fields override it.

left.name: Left (x)
left.description: Left edge, as a fraction of the image width (0 = left).

top.name: Top (y)
top.description: Top edge, as a fraction of the image height (0 = top).

width.name: Width
width.description: Width as a fraction of the image width (1 = whole image).

height.name: Height
height.description: Height as a fraction of the image height (1 = whole image).

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Overwrite pictures that already exist in the destination folder.

model_missing.message: The model files are missing ({path}). Upload the model again from the integration options or re-add the integration.

model_invalid.message: The stored model cannot be loaded ({error}).

invalid_config_entry.message: {entry_id} is not a Snapshot Classifier entry.

invalid_crop.message: Invalid crop: width and height must be greater than 0 and the box must be inside the image (x + width ≤ 1, y + height ≤ 1).

path_not_allowed.message: {path} is not an allowed absolute path (see allowlist_external_dirs; /media is allowed by default).

same_directory.message: Source and destination folders must be different.
